concepts.name: Clarity
concepts.subtitle: Quiet confidence. Research comes first.
concepts.note: A bright, spacious portfolio with a centered introduction, soft grouped surfaces, and a clear route from research to evidence. Recommended for academic and industry audiences.

concepts.name: Focus
concepts.subtitle: Technical depth, presented with impact.
concepts.note: A dark, cinematic direction with a large typographic introduction, a restrained signal graphic, and generous project spotlights. Best for a stronger engineering identity.

concepts.name: Studio
concepts.subtitle: A personal home for serious work.
concepts.note: A warm editorial direction with a persistent desktop navigation rail, a portrait-led introduction, and quieter reading pages. Best for a more personal portfolio.
